name: Magway Region (Myanmar)
description: A yellow field charged in the centre with the regional emblem and the region's name in Burmese script.
history: Used by the Magway Region government as one of Myanmar's 14 first-level administrative subdivisions (seven regions and seven states, plus Naypyidaw Union Territory). Many regional and state flag designs follow a common pattern based on the national flag, charged with the regional seal.
